Fixed and shipped. The expired/corrupt/re-entrant reclaim path is now exclusive via a <claim>.json.reclaim lock, with a re-read of the claim INSIDE the lock as the actual decision — a late worker reads an active claim that is not its own and loses. Neither the lock nor the re-read alone is sufficient, so both are there. A lock orphaned by a dead worker ages out after RECLAIM_LOCK_SECONDS and is stolen, following the same rule as the lease, and the re-read still guards the write. The lock file does not match the *.json glob so nothing reads it as a claim. Five tests including the threaded two-worker race; three fail against the unfixed file on every run.
